title: Pinwheel tiling
description: A 100x100x30mm tray must hold five modules: a (60x40x25mm), b (40x60x25mm), c (60x40x25mm), d (40x60x25mm), e (20x20x10mm). Nothing may overlap and everything must be fully inside the tray. Modules cannot be rotated: the sizes are [x,y,z] as given. Return the min-corner [x,y,z] of each module in millimeters.
